briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.2%), giving no clear risk-on signal to deploy capital. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 threshold and open positions are being left alone to let stop-loss/profit-target rules work automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: On days without a clear bullish signal, disciplined investors often choose to hold cash rather than force a trade. Waiting for stronger confirmation (like a volume surge plus a MACD crossover) helps avoid buying into weak or directionless momentum.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 在缺乏明確好淡訊號嘅日子，紀律嚴明嘅投資者通常會揸住現金，而唔會強行入市。等待更強嘅確認訊號（例如成交量急升配合MACD黃金交叉）可以避免喺動力疲弱或方向不明時貿然買入。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with the NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, consistent with a quiet, directionless trading session rather than any major catalyst-driven move.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅整理，納指跌0.3%，標普500跌0.2%，屬於缺乏明顯催化劑的淡靜交投日子。
